acceptance_statements: ACCEPT only if the lettering reads exactly "FLAT 40% OFF", "First 100 members only" and "AlphaFit" — every character as given; REJECT on any wrong, missing, doubled or invented character.
REJECT if any other lettering or pseudo-lettering appears anywhere, or if any of the required lettering is cut by the frame edge or overlaps other lettering.
ACCEPT only if the lower-right corner is empty ground with nothing on it.
REJECT if any person, photograph or product appears.
REJECT if any colour other than black, white and neon yellow carries the design.

composition.attention_order: 1st read: "FLAT 40% OFF" by scale and neon-on-black contrast; 2nd read: "First 100 members only"; 3rd read: "AlphaFit" and the date line.
composition.edge_treatment: tight fit with a deliberate margin around the headline; no letter touches the frame edge
composition.placement_zone: headline block off-centre in the upper-left zone; the lower-right corner is left clean for the customer's logo, a visible reason for the asymmetry

generation_prompts.textless_plate: Square social-media background image. Solid black background with a single wide diagonal neon-yellow stripe running from lower-left to upper-right; no people, no photographs, no objects. The upper-left two-thirds and the lower-left are plain black space; the lower-right corner stays completely empty. High contrast, energetic. No text, no letters, no numerals, no symbols anywhere in the image.

hard_constraints: the string 'FLAT 40% OFF' appears character-exact and is not re-flowed, re-spelled or re-typeset
the string 'First 100 members only' appears character-exact and is not re-flowed, re-spelled or re-typeset
the string 'AlphaFit' appears character-exact and is not re-flowed, re-spelled or re-typeset
the copy reads exactly "FLAT 40% OFF", "First 100 members only" and "AlphaFit" — 'It has to say ...'
no pictures of people — 'No pictures of people'
black and neon yellow only — 'Use our brand colours, black and neon yellow'
one corner stays empty for the logo — 'just leave a clean corner for it'

materials_and_light.implied_light_source: none — a flat graphic plate with no scene lighting; contrast comes from colour, not from light
materials_and_light.surface_finish_per_key_object: solid matte black ground; matte neon-yellow stripe; no gloss anywhere

blueprint.objective: Produce a square Instagram post for AlphaFit's New Year offer whose four lines of copy are set exactly, bold and energetic in black and neon yellow, with a clean corner left for the customer's logo.
